name: Correctional Church
source:
Welcome to a world where faith is not salvation, but chains.
Where the Church controls every breath, every thought, every “wrong” feeling.
Correctional Church is a visual novel in the genre of totalitarian setting, where fear, lust for power and human weaknesses are hidden under the mask of piety.
You are an ordinary high school student who has forgotten your past life.
A new life. A new family. Foster mother. Step-sister. You live happily together... until the Church finds out about the sin.
This world demands obedience.
But maybe it's time to break the rules?
translation:
欢迎来到一个信仰不是救赎而是锁链的世界。
教会控制着每一次呼吸、每一个想法、每一个“错误”的感觉。
《惩教教堂》是一部极权主义背景下的视觉小说，在虔诚的面具下隐藏着恐惧、权力欲和人性弱点。
你是一个忘记了前世的普通高中生。
新的生活。一个新的家庭。养母。继妹。你们幸福地生活在一起……直到教会发现罪恶。
这个世界需要服从。
但也许是时候打破规则了？
